items.briefing:
Australian organisations are being reminded that staff awareness alone isn't enough to stop cyber threats — stronger technical controls need to back it up. Separately, a warning has been issued about a common but overlooked risk: improperly redacted documents. Simply drawing a black box over sensitive text in PDFs doesn't always hide the underlying data, which can be easily recovered. Businesses handling confidential records should ensure they use proper redaction tools, not just visual overlays.

Merchants are also being warned about internal fraud risks, with reports suggesting many businesses lack adequate visibility into employee-driven financial misconduct. **Practical tip:** Before sharing any redacted document externally, test it by copying and pasting the "hidden" text to confirm it's truly removed.

featured.title: Businesses urged to add stronger controls beyond vigilance
featured.summary: Rising scam losses are pushing Australian firms towards stronger payment and login controls as regulators prepare tougher enforcement.
